name: vital-mcp
description: Design, edit and explain presets for the Vital wavetable synth.
long_description: Create and edit Vital presets in plain language: oscillators, wavetables, filters, envelopes, LFOs, the modulation matrix, macros and effects, with every parameter in friendly units. Presets are saved to Vital's User/Presets/MCP folder. To also render presets through the Vital plugin and analyze how they sound, install vital-mcp-render.mcpb instead.

vital_data_dir.title: Vital folder (optional)
vital_data_dir.description: Vital's data folder. Leave empty to find it automatically (usually Music/Vital on macOS, Documents/Vital on Windows).

tools.name: list_presets
tools.description: Search the presets in your Vital folder

tools.name: describe_preset
tools.description: Readable breakdown of a preset: oscillators, wavetables, filters, envelopes, LFOs, modulation, macros, effects

tools.name: get_preset_parameters
tools.description: Exact parameter values in display units

tools.name: list_parameters
tools.description: Look up Vital parameter names, ranges, defaults and options

tools.name: create_preset
tools.description: Build and save a new preset

tools.name: edit_preset
tools.description: Change an existing preset in place (with backup) or as a copy

tools.name: render_preset
tools.description: Play a preset through the Vital plugin offline, save a WAV and analyze the sound (needs the rendering bundle, vital-mcp-render.mcpb)
